site_name: Google Kansas City data center at Hunt Midwest Business Center, Clay County
notes: Resolves the 'Evergy, two EIA matches' case from round 1. Google's application to intervene in Missouri PSC File No. EO-2025-0154 (Evergy's large-load tariff case), served 5 March 2025, says: 'Google is currently developing a data center in the Kansas City area within the EMM territory', EMM being Evergy Missouri Metro. The filing does not name the site; in March 2025 the Hunt Midwest project announced in March 2024 was Google's one announced Kansas City data center, hence medium and not high. The HIFLD territory polygon puts the point in Evergy Missouri West, so this overrides the polygon. Google's later intervention in the Evergy Metro rate case (File No. ER-2026-0143, 27 February 2026) says it is developing data centers in the area 'including within EMM's service territory', which leaves room for a second site elsewhere. Epoch dates first power to 2026, so this site carries no load in the 2001-2025 panel either way.

site_name: Iron Mountain WPA-1 (underground data center), 1137 Branchton Rd, Boyers
serving_utility: West Penn Power (West Penn Rate District of FirstEnergy Pennsylvania Electric Company)
notes: Resolves the 'FirstEnergy, operating company not stated' case from the Pennsylvania sweep. FirstEnergy Pennsylvania Electric Company's retail tariff (Electric Pa P.U.C. No. 1, Supplement No. 40, effective 1 October 2026), Description of Territory, Butler County, lists Cherry and Marion townships under the West Penn Rate District; the Penn Power Rate District in Butler County covers only Adams, Connoquenessing, Cranberry, Forward, Jackson and Lancaster townships and a few boroughs. FirstEnergy's West Penn Power zip-code list includes 16020 Boyers and its Penn Power list does not. Iron Mountain's own page names FirstEnergy as the utility. Caveat for the panel: West Penn Power reports to EIA under its own id through 2023 and inside FirstEnergy Pennsylvania Electric Co (a new id) from 2024; the panel does not yet join predecessors to the successor (see the open item in docs/DECISIONS.md). Start year still not sourced: the operator claims over 30 years of colocation at the site.

site_name: Digital Realty ORD12, 9333 W Grand Ave, Franklin Park (first building of the Digital Chicago campus)
year_evidence_quote: 9333 W Grand Ave (ORD12) | Illinois | Digital Realty | Year Constructed 2014
notes: Replaces the 2013 that round 2 took from a June 2012 trade-press article saying the first phase 'is expected to be delivered and operational by mid-2013'. Round 3 does not accept forward-looking statements (D-15), and its verifier rejected the same article for this building's duplicate permit row (bi:1195-0, now dropped as a duplicate of this id). EPA's ENERGY STAR registry lists the building with Year Constructed 2014, and its two neighbours ORD13 and ORD14 with 2015 and 2016. One year later than the expectation; the registry is the record.
